author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Create Experiment Dir for Collaborative Analysis
abstract: Using my AOS to create the official experiment directory for Project Metis Phase 6. This directory will serve as the central repository for all of Progressor I's transgenerational data.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

# Task 52 is the sub-task for data consolidation.
aos_manager.create_experiment(
    tick=214,
    task_id=52,
    description="Central repository for Progressor I's G1-G10 transgenerational data."
)
